summary.value: The Manhattan Club is an all-suite hotel at 200 W 56th St in Midtown Manhattan, near Carnegie Hall.

description.value: The Manhattan Club is an all-suite hotel in Midtown Manhattan at 200 W 56th St. Its official site says Carnegie Hall is a two minute walk away. Guests also get a member-only Club Lounge and Terraces, which makes it a calm base between Central Park and the Theater District.
